data.name: Sarbjeet
data.gender_notes: Sarbjeet is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sarbjeet is derived from the Sanskrit words 'sarv' meaning 'all' and 'jeet' meaning 'victory'. The name signifies a person who has the power to rule over all things. This name is a symbol of courage, strength, and wisdom. The name Sarbjeet carries the meaning “One who rules all” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi. Parents who choose Sarbjeet usually hope their child will grow to embody one who rules all and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sarbjeet is a name that resonates with the spiritual energy of the Sun God. It is believed that this name brings the blessings of the Sun God, who is the giver of life, energy, and power.
data.etymology: Sarbjeet belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who rules all.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sarbjeet total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
